environment.camera: third person; unchanged room entry spots
environment.limitation: Browser throttled animation to approximately 1 FPS. CPU render submission samples are indicative only. These results do not establish live FPS, GPU frame time, walking performance, or PC2 speed. PC2 must run its own foreground measurement.

initial_default_ghost_model_payload.note: Model payload only; excludes application JS/CSS, HTTP overhead and caching. Byte reduction is not a measurement of elapsed loading time. Compressed files were round-trip verified against originals.

changes: Spatially batch explicitly static decorations while preserving colors, materials and collision surfaces
Keep animated fire, windows, doors, avatars and interactive objects outside static batches
Limit active point lights to six ranked by intensity and camera distance; retain visible lamp meshes
Update shadow maps at up to 8 Hz instead of every rendered frame
Hide greenhouse rendering on floors from which it is not visible
Load the fox only when selected
Lossless gzip model delivery with native streaming decompression and original GLB fallback
Asset URLs include the build version to prevent old model caches
Add opt-in performance panel at ?perf=1 with room selection and insufficient-sample warning
remaining_acceptance: Compare foreground PC2 FPS and frame-time distributions against the prior version under identical resolution, room, lighting, weather and walking conditions before claiming at least 2x end-to-end performance.
